target_customer: Software companies that want AI agents to use their product (CLI generation); originally non-technical operators building agents
problem: Agents hitting a product with no usable interface move on to a competitor; MCP servers and raw APIs are weaker for agents than a CLI, according to the company.
business_model: SaaS tiers: Free, Pro (200 USD per month or 150 annual per the site), Enterprise custom
product_category: Developer tools, CLI generation for AI agents

founders.name: Mahyad Ghassemi
previous_startups: SigmaOS (YC S21), AI-oriented browser, 100,000+ users per YC page
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a 2x YC founder.

founders.name: Saurav Mitra
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating a working CLI from arbitrary codebases in any language needs code analysis and reliable agent tooling, but builds on existing LLM capability.

defensibility.rationale: Agent platforms and the vendors themselves can ship CLIs; the company's own site says 30+ companies already launched first-party agent CLIs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not determined from sources; no incumbent action against Okibi found.

market_need_then: In mid 2025 no-code agent builders were crowded; the CLI direction rides the later shift to agents as customers, per the YC description.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct developer pitch; 'Turn your product into a CLI, and agents into customers'

branding.community_and_virality: Launched on Product Hunt and YC Launches in July 2025 (listings only).

brand_strength.rationale: Easy name and the SigmaOS founders' track record, but no press about the brand itself was found.

pivots.from: Okibi as a no-code agent builder ('Lovable for agents', launched July 2025)
pivots.to: Generating CLIs from products so agents can use them
pivots.why: Not stated; the pivot date is not sourced.

outcome_analysis: Okibi is the second YC company from the SigmaOS founders. It launched as a no-code agent builder in July 2025 and has since repositioned around generating CLIs for agents. No sourced funding beyond aggregator claims, no exit and no shutdown were found. The company is early and its defensibility depends on staying ahead of agent platforms and product vendors.
notes: VCBacked and Choppingblock list 500K pre-seed in September 2025 with Y Combinator and Pioneer Fund; both are aggregators, unverified, so no round is recorded. A Standout listing showing 2.0M seed belongs to SigmaOS, not Okibi. YC page note: the founder bios appear to be written for the earlier agent builder product. No dated competitors near the batch were sourced (directory lists only). Outcome search returned only unrelated companies.
